_source: AI_LAB_UNIVERSITY.md - Certification and graduation sections. Encoded, not redesigned.
_rule: Certification is portfolio-based, never exam-based. The post-mortem is the assessment.

required_submissions.note: Must be publicly reachable. A localhost demo teaches nothing about what actually goes wrong.

required_submissions.statement: An incident the student caused deliberately, with the log showing it
required_submissions.note: Reproducing the failure on purpose is the pedagogical core.

required_submissions.statement: A written post-mortem in the Lab failure format
required_submissions.note: This is the assessment. See rubric.json.

certificate_records: the curriculum version in force at assessment

requirements.statement: Four of six competencies certified, including Operating
One production system live and publicly reachable for at least 30 days
One accepted contribution to a Lab failure doc or a research dataset
requirements.note: This is what makes the institution compound: every graduate leaves the corpus larger than they found it.

requirements.statement: One post-mortem of a failure the student did not cause
requirements.note: Proves they can read someone else's evidence.
